protocol: Two contexts in one process: first compiles four user kernels verbatim at runtime, second loads offline library compiled from the exact same file with identical flags. Both execute through the full NativeRenderer. Variant order alternates every frame; three trials, 500 warm-up and 500 timed frames per variant and case. Validation off, no concurrent compiler/GPU workload; pixel equality asserted per case/trial. Prior sequential measurements are retained, including startup variance.

preliminary_separate_process.protocol: Exact same complete user Metal file, Metal 2.4, no fast math, preserve invariance; actual NativeRenderer checkerboard backdrop, four region-dispatched passes with RGBA16F intermediates and extra tint image, capture/composite/submit/wait included, compilation and readback excluded. Three alternating-order trials, 80 warmup + 160 timed frames each. Serial GPU runs, validation off. Ordinary control: committed HEAD 7e53dfd versus pipeline renderer in same process, order alternated every frame, three trials, 500 warmup + 1000 timed frames per variant.
